0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4, 3-2 at home) are coming off three straight wins and sit 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back and 5th in the East, while the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 0-4 on the road) have lost six straight and are 5th in the Central, 6 games back and 15th in the East. Josh Hart is out for New York with an illness, and Milwaukee is without Tyler Herro, who is out with a knee bruise. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on 2026-02-27.
